description:
pkix-path/tests/ contains: pkits_4_1_4_2.rs, pkits_4_3.rs, pkits_4_6_4_7.rs, pkits_4_13.rs, pkits_policy.rs, pkits_smoke.rs.

PKITS §4.13 tests NameConstraints. These test files should cover NC violation cases. However looking at the test structure, the tests use pkits_validate() which by default uses ValidationPolicy::new() with no special NC-enforcing configuration. The PKITS §4.13 tests should include both valid-path (PASS) and invalid-path (FAIL) cases.

Without seeing the full content of pkits_4_13.rs, there may be adequate coverage. But anchor_nc.rs exists which covers trust anchor NC. The test coverage appears to be:
- PKITS fixtures (binary, committed) — external oracle
- anchor_nc.rs — tests for trust anchor NC seeding

The CRL checker and OCSP checker tests have good coverage of error paths. The chain_walk NC tests need verification.

P2 — needs inspection to confirm whether PKITS §4.13 negative cases are tested.
title: pkix-path tests: PKITS tests have no coverage for NC violations (only happy paths)
